name: coordinate-noise-study-v1
question: Can an explicit planar-translation-invariant representation and consistent observation-noise augmentation improve low-data closed-loop robustness?
validation_selection: minimum clean held-out episode validation loss
primary_endpoint: unweighted mean success over position, sensor_3mm, delay_50ms, dynamics, combined
limitations: custom Cartesian task, not a standard benchmark
five seeds vary both dataset subset and optimization
noise levels are known at design time, so this is not unknown-noise generalization
no external evaluation or public impact established
